description: This file implements the functionality for controlling a stepper motor within a firmware project, including position saving/loading, motor control logic, thread management, and pin configuration.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Class representing a stepper motor with methods for initialization, position control, and movement.

methods.name: void saveStepperPos(int pos)
methods.description: Saves the current position of the stepper motor to backup storage.

methods.name: int loadStepperPos()
methods.description: Loads the saved position of the stepper motor from backup storage.

methods.name: msg_t stThread(StepperMotor * motor)
methods.description: Thread function managing stepper motor movements based on target positions.

methods.name: StepperMotor()
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a stepper motor instance.

methods.name: int getTargetPosition()
methods.description: Retrieves the target position for the motor.

methods.name: void setTargetPosition(int targetPosition)
methods.description: Sets a new target position for the motor.

methods.name: void setDirection(bool isIncrementing)
methods.description: Sets the direction of motor movement.

methods.name: void pulse()
methods.description: Sends a pulse to the motor to move one step.

methods.name: void initialize(brain_pin_e stepPin,brain_pin_e directionPin,pin_output_mode_e directionPinMode,float reactionTime,int totalSteps,brain_pin_e enablePin,Logging * sharedLogger)
methods.description: Initializes the stepper motor with specified pins and configuration.
